subject: Page Buldini City Council Candidacy
overview: In this candidate interview, Page Buldini discussed her platform for Medford City Council, focusing on small business advocacy, zoning reform, and enhanced city communication. She emphasized her background as a local business owner and her commitment to active listening in municipal government.

items.title: Introduction and Background
items.summary: Page Buldini introduced herself as a 15-year Medford resident, parent, and owner of a hillside skincare salon who serves on the Chamber of Commerce board.

items.title: Motivations for Running
items.summary: Buldini explained that her experience connecting business owners with city decision-makers and listening to diverse clients motivated her to seek office.

items.title: Campaign Priorities and Zoning Reform
items.summary: Key priorities include streamlining business permitting at City Hall, improving digital communication for residents, and navigating complex zoning reform. Buldini expressed support for mixed-use development on business corridors but stated she has publicly advocated for slowing the current zoning process to ensure better public understanding.

items.title: Inclusivity and Community Building
items.summary: The candidate discussed fostering equity by diversifying the local business landscape and supporting arts and school programs that make residents feel seen and valued.

items.title: Campaign Logistics and Library Resources
items.summary: Buldini shared information about her upcoming campaign barbecues and praised the Medford Public Library for its 'rent a librarian' service and historical archives.
